findings.evidence: In `pkg/infoschema/infoschema_v2.go:1066` (`(*infoschemaV2).ListTablesWithSpecialAttribute`), dedup is keyed only by `lastTableID` (`pkg/infoschema/infoschema_v2.go:1076-1080`) even though resident entries are ordered/keyed by `dbName` then `tableID` (`compareTableInfoItem` in `pkg/infoschema/infoschema_v2.go:263-278`). For cross-DB rename, the same `tableID` can appear under two different `dbName` values at the same `schemaVersion`: drop path inserts a tomb in old DB (`applyDropTableV2` calls `infoData.remove` with `dbInfo.Name.L` in `pkg/infoschema/infoschema_v2.go:934-960`; `Data.remove` writes a tomb resident entry in `pkg/infoschema/infoschema_v2.go:216-226`), and create path inserts the live entry in new DB (`Builder.addTable` uses `di.Name.L` in `pkg/infoschema/builder.go:951-960`; `Data.add` writes the live resident entry in `pkg/infoschema/infoschema_v2.go:187-204` when `hasSpecialAttributes` is true). If the tomb entry is visited first and no other resident items with different tableIDs intervene, `lastTableID` causes the subsequent live entry (same tableID, different dbName) to be skipped.
findings.fix: Change dedup to match the actual resident key: dedup by `(dbName, tableID)` (or `(dbName, tableID, schemaVersion)` if needed), not by `tableID` alone. Minimal fix: track `lastDB` + `lastTableID` and only skip when both match, so cross-DB rename entries for the same tableID don’t suppress each other.
findings.impact: `InfoSchema.ListTablesWithSpecialAttribute` can incorrectly omit TTL/TiFlash (and `AllSpecialAttribute`) tables after a cross-database `RENAME TABLE`/`ALTER TABLE ... RENAME TO other_db.*`, which can stop TTL cache/worker discovery and TiFlash refresh from seeing the table, leading to stale/missing background management behavior and inconsistent metadata visibility for these features.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked `upstream/master` as of this workspace: `pkg/infoschema/infoschema_v2.go` still orders resident items by `dbName` first (`compareTableInfoItem`) and still dedups only by `lastTableID` in `ListTablesWithSpecialAttribute`, so the edge case appears unfixed upstream.
findings.verify: Add a regression test (e.g. extend `pkg/infoschema/test/infoschemav2test/v2_test.go`) that: (1) creates a TTL-enabled table (or TiFlash replica table) in `db2`, (2) renames it into `db1`, (3) asserts `InfoSchema().ListTablesWithSpecialAttribute(infoschema.AllSpecialAttribute)` returns it under `db1` and not under `db2`, for both `tidb_schema_cache_size > 0` (v2) and `= 0` (v1).
findings.what: `infoschema` v2 `ListTablesWithSpecialAttribute` can miss special-attribute tables after cross-database rename because it deduplicates resident entries using only `tableID`, while resident entries are keyed/ordered by `(dbName, tableID, schemaVersion)`, allowing a tomb entry for the old DB to suppress the live entry for the new DB.

subject: *: keep in-memory resident for model.TableInfo with special attributes (#53301)
summary: Adds `InfoSchema.ListTablesWithSpecialAttribute` and keeps `model.TableInfo` resident for “special attribute” tables in infoschema v2; found a High-severity correctness edge case where v2 listing can drop TTL/TiFlash tables after cross-database renames due to tableID-only dedup over a `(dbName, tableID, schemaVersion)`-keyed resident index.
